_status_legend.on_resume_now: printed in the sidebar (Txt/p1_sidebar.tex) as of the last update
_status_legend.used_on_earlier_versions: was printed on an earlier version of the resume (so you have claimed it before) but is not on the sidebar now
_status_legend.from_experience_text: evidenced by an Experience or Projects entry, not necessarily a sidebar token
_status_legend.unverified_candidates: only ever appeared in the commented-out 'menu' in p1_sidebar.tex or in the original template. NOT confirmed as real skills. Never add to a resume without confirming with Hasan.

_flagged_additions._note: Skills added to a resume instance because the job required them and the resume lacked them (max 3 per instance, each flagged to Hasan). Log them here.
